item.title: How To Prevent Osteoporosis and Promote Bone Health
item.description: Osteoporosis is a disease that weakens bones and can make them so brittle that they break easily. Common osteoporosis-related fractures are those of the hip, wrist, and spine, and some cases can be caused by a cough or even by bending over. Is osteoporosis an inevitable part of aging, or are there dietary and lifestyle strategies that can keep your bones healthy and strong?

item.title: Are You Eating Plastic? What’s Really in Your Chewing Gum (and the Healthiest Alternatives)
item.description: That seemingly innocuous piece of chewing gum may be anything but: Most conventional brands are made from synthetic polymers — the same stuff used in plastic bottles. But does this plastic actually get ingested when we chew? Does gum chewing have any upsides for dental health? What’s better: sugared or sugar-free gum? What are the surprising findings regarding gum chewing and your ability to focus on demanding cognitive tasks? And which brands of chewing gum are best for us and for the planet?

item.title: What’s So Great About Nut Cheese – and How to Make Your Own
item.description: Many aspiring plant-based eaters and vegans stumble over cheese. The thought of giving up their ooey-gooey pizza topping or caprese salad has proven just too much. But fear not, cheese lovers: A new hero has arrived! Welcome to the wonderful world of nut cheese.

item.title: Is Grass-Fed Beef Good for Your Health & the Planet?
item.description: Grass-fed beef is often marketed as a healthier, more eco-friendly, and more ethical option for red meat-eaters. Is grass-fed really better than conventionally-raised beef? And can it be good for your health or the planet?

item.title: Hydrogen Water: A Guide to Its Health Benefits, Safety, and the Truth Behind the Hype
item.description: What is hydrogen-infused water? Is it a real health breakthrough or just another expensive wellness fad? Is it safe? And what does the research say about its ability to boost athletic performance, fight oxidative stress and inflammation, and prevent and treat chronic disease?

item.title: Are Flaxseeds Good for You? — And the Best Ways to Eat Them
item.description: Flaxseeds are nutritional superstars. They’re rich in omega-3 fatty acids, phytoestrogens, fiber, protein, and lignans. Studies show that they may help fight heart disease, type 2 diabetes, and cancer. But if you don’t eat them the right way, they can go “in one end and out the other.” And both flax oil and flaxseed meal can degrade very quickly. Plus, some critics worry that flaxseed is high in dangerous chemicals. So is flax good or bad? And how can you eat and enjoy it safely?

item.title: Anxiety Self Help Strategies Using Diet & Lifestyle
item.description: The times we’re living in can make just about anybody feel anxious. While we can’t easily change the state of the world, there are many actions we can take to reduce our anxious responses to it. In this article, we’ll look at what anxiety is, what causes it, and the simple dietary and lifestyle changes demonstrated to help.

item.title: 5 Fabulous Vegan Soups You’ll Want to Whip Up Straight Away
item.description: Soup’s on! When the weather is dreary, nothing beats a steaming pot of soup. No matter what your heritage, there’s a classic soup back there somewhere. And chances are that it originated from the need to use up leftovers and stretch the household budget. But how can you make delicious and nourishing soup without meat, dairy, or unhealthy additives? Let’s check out the world of vegan soups and get cooking!
